realms.name: Orynvell
realms.role: Sacred imperial seat, center of royal legitimacy, succession law, and AETHERCORE-adjacent authority.
realms.climate: Temperate celestial seasons with shimmering auroral night skies and high-frequency harmonic atmospheric clarity.

realms.name: Fross
realms.role: Sovereign border realm of endurance, survival, cold-weather discipline, and ancient winter rites. Southwake acts as the civil administrative capital, while Northwake anchors the northern winter fortress.
realms.climate: Sub-zero glacial plains, heavy blizzards, permafrost tundra with brief seasonal summer thaws.

realms.name: Lumia
realms.role: Realm of illumination, civic ceremony, solar law, expansive academies, and radiant public legitimacy.
realms.climate: Sun-drenched Mediterranean climate with long daylight hours, solar winds, and dry golden summers.

realms.name: Marlowe
realms.role: Lower-left island realm of seasonal renewal, river conduits, deep estuaries, healing currents, and diplomatic sanctuaries.
realms.climate: Temperate oceanic rainfall, coastal mists, lush vernal riverbanks, and rhythmic seasonal tidal swells.

realms.name: Brisland
realms.role: Realm of sweeping trade winds, cultural preservation, global dispatches, migration crossings, and autumnal judgment.
realms.climate: Vibrant autumnal foliage, brisk coastal gales, shifting cloud shelves, and periodic squall systems.

realms.name: Kaji
realms.role: Volcanic power, military industry, passionate artisans, technological forge craft, and sacred flame. Kailo Islands, Kanifan Deserts, and Volcanic Fields of Pyre belong to Kaji under unified jurisdiction.
realms.climate: Thermal volcanic plumes, arid desert winds, geothermal hot springs, and mineral-rich volcanic ash plains.

realms.name: Nephele
realms.role: Nether realm of ancestral depths, hidden law, obsidian architecture, grief work, and taboo metaphysical knowledge.
realms.climate: Low-light ambient violet glow, persistent obsidian mist, subterranean geysers, and serene atmospheric twilight.

realms.name: Ve’Raylia
realms.role: Inland sovereign realm of ancient forests, sacred groves, mountain sanctuaries, fertile valleys, and monumental stone heritage.
realms.climate: Temperate highland mists, deep canopy shade, mineral spring valleys, and rich seasonal harvests.

landmarks.name: Marlie Sea
landmarks.description: Central maritime expanse connecting Orynvell, Marlowe, and Brisland.

landmarks.name: Northold Ocean
landmarks.description: Vast, deep northern ocean flanking the frozen coastlines of Fross.

landmarks.name: Angel Bay
landmarks.description: Ceremonial harbor and sacred coast adjoining Aureline Crown District.

landmarks.name: Glowing Gulf of Meri
landmarks.description: Luminescent coastal gulf reflecting bioluminescent reefs between Lumia and Marlowe.

landmarks.name: Kailo Islands
landmarks.description: Island chain of basalt sea stacks and maritime artisan outposts. Integral part of Kaji jurisdiction.

landmarks.name: Kanifan Deserts
landmarks.description: Vast sandstone expanse and wind-swept dunes of western Kaji.

landmarks.name: Volcanic Fields of Pyre
landmarks.description: Active geothermal fissure network and primary foundry basin of Kaji.

landmarks.name: Fross Fields & Glaciers
landmarks.description: Expansive glacial shelves and tundra stretching between Northwake and Southwake.

landmarks.name: Sacred Groves & Stone Formations
landmarks.description: Inland ancient forest sanctuaries, fertile valleys, and monumental stone formations surrounding Elmore.

venues.name: Storyloom Animation Workshop

venues.name: The Rosemont Portrait House

venues.name: Glassline Designs Atelier
